question:
Simplify.

15 - 6.3 ÷ 7 + 3 × 1.3 - 2
solution:
**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe9eb58ef2c9768e79708de967f6e1864bcd0ec90531603a61eeeed9701685d1.png] 

**Calculations:**

Solve as per above given order

15 - 6.3 ÷ 7 + 3 × 1.3 - 2

⇒ 15 - 0.9 + 3.9 - 2

⇒ 15 + 3 - 2

⇒ 16

**∴ The correct choice is option 3.**
